input: Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num and be co-signed by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, so a move only counts when it names its ply and carries the team's agreement, while every existing per-agent signature requirement stays in force.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false)
